 WTA Ningbo Day 4 Predictions Including Elena Rybakina vs Polina Kudermetova 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 Day 4 at the WTA 500 event in Ningbo has a mouthwatering lineup, led by the World #1, Elena Rybakina . While she is the clear favorite to win this title, there are plenty of other strong players in this event who will do their to get a scalp over the world #1 and win an important title. It has been a great tournament so far, and this Thursday will certainly be no different.
 WTA Ningbo Day 4 Predictions
 Iva Jovic vs Jasmine Paolini
 Head-to-head: Paolini 2-1 Jovic
 Paolini had won their two matchups in 2025, but this year Jovic beat her in Australia and has completely surpassed her as an overall player. While Paolini has dropped out of the Top 30, Jovic is closing in on the Top 10 (and will almost certainly reach it next year) and will be looking to finish the year strong and with momentum going into 2027. She should be able to advance here.
 Prediction: Jovic in 2
 Katarzyna Kawa vs Belinda Bencic
 Head-to-head: first meeting
 At least on paper, this is the most one-sided match of the day. Although Bencic hasn’t been playing at her best lately, against an opponent ranked outside the Top 100 she should have a very clear edge. Kawa played very well in qualifying and in the first round here, but Bencic is a significant step up in level and she is unlikely to continue her run here.
 Prediction: Bencic in 2
 Jul 7, 2025; Wimbledon, United Kingdom; Belinda Bencic of Switzerland celebrates winning her match against Ekaterina Alexandrova on day eight at All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club. Mandatory Credit: Susan Mullane-Imagn Images 
 Alexandra Eala vs Diana Shnaider
 Head-to-head: first meeting
 This is a matchup between two young players who had breakthrough years and will have a great chance to get into the Top 10 soon. Both will be looking to end the season on a high note and there is very little to choose between them. It should be a very close match, decided by small details and execution on the biggest points.
 Prediction: Shnaider in 3
 Elena Rybakina vs Polina Kudermetova
 Head-to-head: Rybakina 1-0 Kudermetova
 Althought Kudermetova is a far mor dangerous opponent than her ranking would suggest, Rybakina has won two Slams this year and has established herself as the best player in the world. She is looking to have a strong finish to bookend the best year of her career and it is highly unlikely that Kudermetova can stop her here.
 Prediction: Rybakina in 2
